findings.description: Constructor accepts any dictionary of prices without checking that each value is a non-negative integer, violating the specification that Catalog must hold non-negative integer prices.
findings.evidence: Line 2-4: __init__ initializes self._prices = dict(prices) with no validation; negative or non-integer values are silently stored.

review.summary: Candidate implementation fails to enforce non-negative integer price values on construction, violating the contract that Catalog must hold non-negative integer prices.
